turns.text: She said, "I'll cover your shift if you cover my shift on Friday." That phrase is key.
turns.zh: 她说：「你替我周五的班，我就替你今天的班。」这个说法很关键。

turns.text: I'll do this if you do that.
turns.zh: 「你帮我做这个，我就帮你做那个。」

turns.text: It's a very clear way to make a deal.
turns.zh: 这是一种非常清楚的做交易的方式。

turns.text: It's like you're saying, "My help is conditional.
turns.zh: 就像你在说：「我的帮忙是有条件的。

turns.text: It depends on the other person's help." And you can use that same structure for other situations, too.
turns.zh: 这取决于对方帮不帮忙。」而且你也可以把同样的结构用在其他情况上。

turns.text: Like, I'll help you with your homework if you help me with my video game.
turns.zh: 比如，「你帮我做作业，我就帮你打游戏。」

turns.text: Or, I'll lend you my car if you fill it with gas.
turns.zh: 或者，「你帮我把车加满油，我就把车借给你。」
